events.name: -1 to Physical Intelligence with Sergey Levine
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Sergey Levine, co-founder at Physical Intelligence and UC Berkeley professor.
Event Details
10:30am: Doors Open + Mingling
11:00am-12:00pm: Fireside Chat
Sergey Levine is one of the world's top robotics researchers and co-founder at Physical Intelligence. He joined the faculty of the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences at UC Berkeley in fall 2016. His work focuses on machine learning for decision making and control, with an emphasis on deep learning and reinforcement learning algorithms. Applications of his work include autonomous robots and vehicles, as well as applications in other decision-making domains. His research includes developing algorithms for end-to-end training of deep neural network policies that combine perception and control, scalable algorithms for inverse reinforcement learning, deep reinforcement learning algorithms, and more. He received a BS and MS in Computer Science from Stanford University in 2009, and a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Stanford University in 2014.

events.name: Fireside Chat with Tony Zhao, Sunday Robotics
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Tony Zhao, co-founder and CEO at Sunday Robotics, for a fireside chat.
Event Details
5:30pm: Doors Open
6:00-7:00pm: Fireside Chat

Tony Zhao is the co-founder and CEO of Sunday Robotics. He is building general-purpose home robots that give people time back for what matters most. He earned his B.S. in EECS from UC Berkeley in 2021 and later pursued a PhD in Computer Science at Stanford. His research in robotic fine manipulation contributed to ALOHA and ACT, influential projects and methods that helped advance imitation learning in robotics. Before founding Sunday Robotics, Tony worked at Google DeepMind and Tesla Autopilot.

events.name: -1 to Anduril with Trae Stephens
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Trae Stephens as part of our -1 to Now series.
Event Details
3:00pm: Doors Open + Mingling
3:30-4:30pm: Fireside Chat

Trae is a General Partner at Founders Fund. He is also Co-founder and Executive Chairman of Anduril Industries, a defense technology company focused on autonomous systems.
Previously, Trae was an early employee at Palantir Technologies, where he led teams focused on growth in the intelligence/defense space as well as international expansion, helping large organizations solve their hardest data analysis problems. He was also an integral part of the product team, leading the design and strategy for new product offerings. While at Palantir, Trae also served as an adjunct faculty member at Georgetown University.
Prior to Palantir, Trae worked as a computational linguist building enterprise solutions to Arabic/Persian name matching and data enrichment within the United States Intelligence community. He began his career working in the office of then Congressman Rob Portman and in the Political Affairs Office at the Embassy of Afghanistan in Washington, D.C. immediately following the installation of Hamid Karzai’s transitional government. Trae graduated from the School of Foreign Service at Georgetown University.
